Similar works in last 7 years: three >= 40%, two >= 50% or one >= 80% of estimated cost
Similar works: roof sheet truss work of multistorey building, solar frame truss work, waterproofing, residential/institutional/office buildings, lighthouse tower or related civil construction
Annual turnover of last three years certified by Chartered Accountant
Unconditional bid declaration; not-blacklisted affidavit on Rs 100 stamp paper; list of relatives (Gazetted/Accounts officers) in MoPSW/DGLL
EPF / labour registration certificate; tender acceptance letter; bid securing declaration
notes: Section I only (pages 2-4); no BOQ or scope details. NIT dated 27.10.2025.
